summary: Feed s068_single is degraded: 27.9% of frames truncated to ~256 bytes, breaking full-payload inspection required by IDS.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker packet slicing/payload slicing is enabled and configured to ~256 bytes, cutting frames short before delivery to the tool. 503 of 1806 frames (27.85%) exceed 5% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS needs_full_payload=true for signature matching, protocol decoding and stream reassembly. Truncated payload causes missed detections, incomplete flows, and false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: IDS requires complete L4 payload; disabling slicing restores full frames for deep packet inspection. If bandwidth is constrained, use filtering or load_balance instead of slicing.
